<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Workstreams_Split" name="Plan the workstreams"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeBankAccount" name="Organize bank account negotiations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckVisaRequirements" name="Check Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa planning is to be reviewed every x months. General requirements stated in the description include a visa application form; a travel document issued within the last ten years, valid in Austria for at least three months beyond the visa duration, with at least two empty pages; a 35 x 45 mm portrait passport photo meeting the specified criteria; fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay, with cover of EUR 30,000 and validity throughout the Schengen area; proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and return journey; other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, which may vary by location; and absence of other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or a Schengen alert.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineRepresentation" name="Determine the competent representation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, state police headquarters may be involved. Schengen visas are handled by the representation of the country of the main travel destination. For equal time in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. For category A and C applications, territorial competence generally belongs to the representation in the consular district of the applicant’s legal place of residence. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence for official actions is based on the foreign national’s place of residence, meaning their centre of interest, verifiable by such evidence as registration forms, a residence permit or a visa. The list of representation offices and their addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements is available on the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs website.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareApplication" name="Prepare visa application and supporting documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the visa application form and the required travel document, passport photo, travel health insurance evidence, proof of sufficient means and other evidence requested by the relevant authorities. Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance for information"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare additional documents requested"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Workstreams_Join" name="Complete the planned workstreams"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Planning steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Split" targetRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Split" targetRef="Task_OrganizeBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Visa" sourceRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckVisaRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_Check_Representation" sourceRef="Task_CheckVisaRequirements" targetRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Representation_Prepare" sourceRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation" targetRef="Task_PrepareApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Contact" sourceRef="Task_PrepareApplication" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Workstreams_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
